what: First real-world usage data: the maintainer installed 0.1.3 into the daily desktop Profile and the startup backfill ran against real sessions.
finding: A 47-day, 75-item backfill is not a review queue. 63 items landed inside one week, so narrowing by time does not help: the volume is the user's real output rate (~9 deliverables/day), not stale history. Flat rendering made the panel unusable.

fix.change: Group the list by session (collapsible), label each group with the last two cwd segments plus item count and newest timestamp; open only the newest group.
fix.secondaryFix: Sort items newest-first in the client and select the newest pending artifact by default. The host returns state-file order, which is not strictly by updatedAt, so the panel previously opened on a week-old item.
fix.verified: Real 75-item state in an isolated Profile: 10 groups, 75 cards retained, exactly 1 group open, detail pane shows the newest artifact, collapse/expand works, zero page/console errors.
fix.dataHandling: The real state file was copied into a temporary DSH_HOME for verification and deleted afterwards; it was never committed.

boundary: Maintainer's own daily use. This is first-hand demand validation, not external adoption: no third-party user, no second-week retention.
